lines.cyr: песна весела со душа и срце,
lines.lat: pesna vesela so duša i srce,
lines.en: a cheerful song with soul and heart,

lines.cyr: мерак имам jас со вас да запеам,
lines.lat: merak imam jas so vas da zapeam,
lines.en: I have the desire to sing with you,
a beautiful song, a Macedonian song.

lines.cyr: Мерак имам jас со вас да запеам,
lines.lat: Merak imam jas so vas da zapeam,
lines.en: I have the desire to sing with you,
a cheerful song, a song of good cheer,
a cheerful song, a Macedonian song.

lines.cyr: Аj со мерак ќе ти засвириме,
lines.lat: Aj so merak ḱe ti zasvirime,
lines.en: Come on, with merak we will play for you,

lines.cyr: и со мерак ќе ти запееме,
lines.lat: i so merak ḱe ti zapeeme,
lines.en: and with merak we will sing for you,

lines.cyr: коj што пее зло не мисли,
lines.lat: koj što pee zlo ne misli,

lines.en: that is what the old people say too.

lines.cyr: Моjата песна знаj сè ќе победи,
lines.lat: Mojata pesna znaj sè ḱe pobedi,
lines.en: Know that my song will conquer everything,

lines.cyr: среќа љубов тоj во песна ќе претвори.
lines.lat: sreḱa ljubov toj vo pesna ḱe pretvori.
lines.en: it will turn happiness and love into song.

lines.cyr: Среќен живот jас со песна поминав
lines.lat: Sreḱen život jas so pesna pominav
lines.en: I spent a happy life with song,

lines.cyr: со песна живеам, со песна ќе умрам.
lines.lat: so pesna živeam, so pesna ḱe umram.
lines.en: I live with song, with song I will die.
